tools.name: get_hook_credits
tools.description: Read your extra admission credit balance.

tools.name: purchase_hook_credits
tools.description: Request an x402 quote without payment, or buy credits with an explicitly authorized signed payment. Reuse purchaseId and the same payment after any timeout.

tools.name: register_destination
tools.description: Create an isolated access. Keep recoveryKey secret and reuse it only with the same target on retries.

tools.name: verify_destination
tools.description: Verify the well-known challenge file and activate your destination.

tools.name: revoke_destination
tools.description: Permanently revoke client access. Previously accepted deliveries finish.

tools.name: accept_hook_event
tools.description: Enqueue an event for your verified receiver, idempotent by eventId and exact bytes.

tools.name: get_hook_delivery
tools.description: Read delivery state and signed observations.

tools.name: verify_hook_receipt
tools.description: Verify a relay receipt within your authenticated hook.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_destination" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
